title: Finitely presented constant local models on the pro-etale site
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and R a commutative ring. For a sheaf F of modules over the constant ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf], say that F has finitely presented constant local models if for every site object V there is a covering sieve T on V such that, for every W→V in T, F restricted to the localized ringed site over W is isomorphic to the sheafification of the constant module presheaf of some finitely presented R-module M [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], using the restricted constant coefficient ring. M may depend on W. No stratification or Noetherian hypothesis is part of this definition.
